title: Nepal Electric, Power & Lights Expo 2026 Receives Extensive Media Coverage
excerpt: National business newspapers and digital publications report on Nepal's electrical, power, lighting and allied industries exhibition.
paragraphs: The fifth Nepal Electric, Power & Lights International Expo 2026 has attracted media attention across business, financial and industry publications in Nepal.

The exhibition serves manufacturers, distributors, suppliers, technology providers and industry professionals across electrical equipment, power infrastructure, renewable energy, lighting and related industries.
Coverage includes original exhibition announcements, media reporting, participation information and subsequent official notices.
Following the postponement of its original September programme, the official exhibition website lists 18–20 December 2026 at Bhrikuti Mandap Exhibition Hall, Kathmandu.
Futurex Group appreciates the recognition from media publications. Browse the original news images, press documents and article references in this archive.
